visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and silver rings holds a white square makeup palette titled 'NNN' toward the camera in a brightly lit studio setting with a neutral background. He opens the palette to reveal ten diverse shades, ranging from nudes to dark browns and shimmers. (2) He proceeds to swatch three shimmering metallic shades on his inner forearm, moving his arm to show how they reflect light. He wears a black Celine t-shirt, and his hand movements are expressive and focused on the product's physical texture. (3) Multiple close-up shots show him using a fine brush to apply different eyeshadows to his lids, starting with a light base and moving to darker crease colors. He looks directly into the camera or slightly off-set, maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (4) The editing includes split-screen moments and fast cuts between the palette and his face, highlighting specific pans as he uses them. He applies a rose-toned shadow as an under-eye accent and completes the look with dark liner. (5) In the final phase, he presents an Instagram feed on a screen overlay and holds a printed photo of a woman with vibrant pink hair, gesturing emotionally while speaking to the camera about her professional growth and success.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic "Tada!" sound effect followed by a high-arousal male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin. An upbeat, rhythmic pop background track with a steady electronic beat and synth textures supports his enthusiastic tone. (2) As he describes the palette, the sound of the plastic lid clicking open is clearly audible. The music continues at a moderate volume, never masking his clear, broadcast-quality articulation which has a friendly and comedic inflection. (3) During the tutorial section, various "whoosh" and "pop" transition sound effects punctuate the cuts between application steps. The speaker's pitch varies significantly to emphasize his excitement about the pigmentation, while the BGM maintains a consistent 124 BPM tempo. (4) The ambient noise is minimal, characteristic of a professional studio recording with high tonal clarity and no technical distortion. The music-to-speech ratio is balanced, allowing the voice to remain dominant throughout the sequence. (5) Toward the end, the BGM's mood shifts slightly as the speaker's volume softens to a more narrative, storytelling tone while discussing the creator's history. A final sparkling sound effect accompanies the closing endorsement, rounding out the high-production-value audio edit.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Feature Review -> Application Tutorial -> Personal Story -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a dual-purpose promotional piece: it provides a detailed tutorial and quality review for Sarah's new 10-color eyeshadow palette while simultaneously paying emotional tribute to the creator's journey from a makeup enthusiast to a brand owner.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the palette, detailed swatches, step-by-step application, and verbal praise for the product's performance.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines high-energy influencer-style reviewing with sincere storytelling, using fast-paced editing and social media screen captures to build credibility and emotional resonance.
